body: AMENDMENT FROM DISPOSABLE VALIDATION — the proposed two-line repair preserves the ec0c439 retro case exactly enough to name features and its consumers, and makes docs successor 8a227832 exit 0 with `no types defined in changed files`. It also exposed a second current defect already present in the unmodified script: the consumer scan treats every root directory with `src/` as an sbt module. Because docs-site/src now exists and contains prose mentioning GraphSuite, the documented 4383a85 retro case emits module `docs-site` and the nonexistent gate `docsSiteJVM/test`. `rg` finds no docsSite project in build.sbt/project. Exact current command reproduces this without the scratch change. The same bead should therefore exclude docs-site from the root-module enumeration (or otherwise validate the mapped project set) and add a court that the 4383a85-shaped case retains align/amr-interop/codec/etc while never emitting docsSiteJVM. Exact paths and priority remain unchanged. Scratch copy only; no project file edited.
